To solve these questions, let's first determine the geometry of the foundation wall based on the provided plan:
- **Dimensions are to the outside face of the wall.**
- Total outside length at the bottom = 44'-0"
- Total outside width on the left = 34'-0"
- Total outside width on the right = 26'-0"
- Top-left section width = 20'-0"
- Offset depth = 8'-0" (so left side is 34'-0" high, right side is 26'-0" high, difference = 8'-0").
- Top-right section length = 24'-0" (20'-0" + 24'-0" = 44'-0", matching the bottom length).

**Perimeter of the outside face of the wall:**
- Left wall: 34 ft
- Bottom wall: 44 ft
- Right wall: 26 ft
- Top-right horizontal wall: 24 ft
- Inner vertical offset wall: 8 ft
- Top-left horizontal wall: 20 ft
- **Total Perimeter** = 34 + 44 + 26 + 24 + 8 + 20 = 156 ft.

**Wall Height:** 10 ft.

---

### **Q1. Number of CMUs (including 5% waste)**
- Nominal CMU face area = 8 in × 16 in = $\frac{8}{12} \times \frac{16}{12} = \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{8}{9}\text{ ft}^2 = 0.8889\text{ ft}^2$.
- Standard rule of thumb: 1.125 CMU per square foot of wall area.
- Total wall surface area (outside face) = Perimeter × Height = $156\text{ ft} \times 10\text{ ft} = 1560\text{ ft}^2$.
- Number of blocks (exact) = $1560\text{ ft}^2 \times 1.125\text{ blocks/ft}^2 = 1755\text{ blocks}$.
- Including 5% waste: $1755 \times 1.05 = 1842.75$, rounding up to nearest whole block = **1843 CMUs**.

---

### **Q2. Fully grouted grout volume (including 10% waste)**
- Grout per fully grouted 6 in CMU = $0.17\text{ ft}^3$.
- Total number of blocks (without waste) = 1755 blocks.
- Total net grout volume = $1755 \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3 = 298.35\text{ ft}^3$.
- Including 10% waste: $298.35 \times 1.10 = 328.185\text{ ft}^3$.
- Convert to cubic yards (CY): $328.185 / 27 = 12.155\text{ CY}$, rounding to two decimal places = **12.16 CY**.

---

### **Q3. Partially grouted grout volume (vertical reinforcement at 32" o.c., including 10% waste)**
- Vertical reinforcement spaced at 32 in (2.667 ft) on center.
- Total perimeter = 156 ft.
- Number of grouted cells = $\frac{156\text{ ft}}{32\text{ in} / 12} = \frac{156}{2.667} = 58.5 \rightarrow 59\text{ vertical cores/columns}$.
- Wall height = 10 ft. Since standard CMUs are 8 in high (0.667 ft), each vertical core contains $10 / 0.667 = 15$ courses (cells stacked vertically per column).
- Total grouted cells = $59\text{ columns} \times 15\text{ cells/column} = 885\text{ cells}$.
- Grout volume per cell = $0.17\text{ ft}^3$.
- Net grout volume = $885 \times 0.17 = 150.45\text{ ft}^3$.
- Including 10% waste: $150.45 \times 1.10 = 165.495\text{ ft}^3$.
- Convert to cubic yards (CY): $165.495 / 27 = 6.13\text{ CY}$.

---

FINAL: Q1 = 1843 CMU
FINAL: Q2 = 12.16 CY
FINAL: Q3 = 6.13 CY
